auth: while nobody has an account: a visitor at home, anyone in the first 15 minutes after the server started, or the setup link's secret in the header X-Share-Setup
notes: Makes the first admin, with a username and password (as PUT /api/me/password takes them), and signs this browser in: its key comes as the cookie, as after a sign-in, and a browser at home gets a session that works only at home. Errors: 400 bad_request (the message names the field), 403 setup_closed, 409 already_set_up once someone has an account.
